summary: Reviewed all 13 skills (skill.json plus rendered SKILL.md) against python3 tools/kb.py show for every distinct cited id (all 313 quoted rows verified as verbatim substrings of at least one cited source, none unsupported by its cite), python3 tools/validate_skills.py --only <name> for each, and live re-execution of every definition_of_done whose status is measured: harness/policy, harness/provenance, harness/state-persistence, harness/observability and harness/tool-access, harness/work-intake all reproduced their recorded clean output, and the policy, provenance and observability breakages reproduced their recorded breakage output exactly (files restored via git checkout, tree left clean). The one high-severity finding is cap-scheduling-implement's definition_of_done: its 'measured' status and measured_run come from harness/workflow/test.sh, the durable-execution harness (steps, idempotency keys, executor markers), not from any RRULE/recurrence check -- the DoD's own 'expected' field describes a never-built recurrence_vectors.py tool that was never run. Every other measured DoD in this set correctly tests its own capability, and every claimed DoD (cap-provenance, cap-scheduling, cap-state-persistence, cap-telemetry, cap-tool-access, cap-work-intake, the six interface-layer skills with no harness yet) honestly discloses 'neither run has been performed here' rather than overclaiming, so that pattern is not a violation. Seven low-severity findings: two are compose-by-name restatement gaps where an operation row (cap-scheduling's fire, cap-work-intake's normalise) restates T-t6-02 under the identical quote cap-errors already carries without naming cap-errors, even though sibling rows in the same skill do name it. Five are the 'X already states F-nnn (sourced) ... what this adds: <uncited new claim>' pattern flagged by validate_skills.py across cap-provenance, cap-state-persistence, cap-tool-access (6 rows), cap-tool-access-implement (8 rows) and cap-work-intake-implement, where the restated fact is sourced but the row's own added consequence carries no citation and is not marked proposed. No fabricated quotes, no bare uncited claims outside that pattern, no definition of done that cannot fail, no adapter pair sharing an execution model or naming a product outside the adapters section, no padding rows, and no description whose trigger clauses fail to fire on the skill's actual scope were found beyond the one DoD mismatch above.
